bagPolicy.summary: The Bell Centre prioritizes security by conducting electronic searches at entrances. Smoking and vaping are prohibited inside the venue.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The Bell Centre is centrally located and easily accessible, with various parking options nearby. Pricing and specific lot details are not provided on the website.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Bell Centre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Bell Centre offers a variety of quick serve counters providing a range of food and beverage options for visitors. Guests can enjoy a quick meal on the go with diverse choices available throughout the venue.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Bell Centre, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Bell Centre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Bell Centre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Bell Centre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
